subject: [PATCH 2/3] mm: page_alloc: make the high-order watermark check honour ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the high-order watermark check in the Linux kernel's page allocation system to honor the ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT flag when allocating memory under defrag_mode. The change ensures that movable allocations do not steal free pages from other migratetypes' blocks, preventing fragmentation and improving performance. Specifically, it updates two functions: __zone_watermark_ok_mt() and __compact_finished(), to skip checking other migratetypes' free lists below pageblock_order for ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT requests. This fix addresses a problem where compaction would stall in certain scenarios, leading to poor performance under memory pressure.
